title: Christmas Concert at The Ozark Mill
seo_title: Christmas Concert at The Ozark Mill, Dec 12, 2026
description: This holiday concert in the Riverside Room features live music and dancing, with Caduceus, a nonprofit 17-piece band of doctors and other professionals, playing holiday favorites and songs from past decades. Tickets include admission, hors d'oeuvres, and a coffee, tea, and hot cocoa bar; the band plays with a short intermission, so you can sit or dance. It takes place Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 7:00 to 9:00 PM at The Ozark Mill in MO, with doors opening at 6:30 PM.
